rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the official SSI docs site, whitepaper gitbook, and search results; catalogued 11 addresses on Base from the official key-addresses page. No GitHub repo or directly accessible audit PDFs were found. Addresses for all non-Base chains (Arbitrum, Ethereum, BSC, Hyperliquid L1, and non-EVM chains) remain undiscovered. The SoDEX Bridge component is described architecturally as a Mirror Protocol using MPC+TEE validators, but no deployed bridge contract addresses were identified in any fetched source.

evidence.shows: Protocol website confirms SoSoValue Indexes (SSI) protocol — fetched minimal metadata, confirms site is live

Official docs list 10 named Base contracts (MAG7.ssi, DEFI.ssi, MEME.ssi, USSI tokens; swap, factory, issuer, rebalancer, feeManager, stakeFactory, assetLocking) plus Protocol OWNER 0xd463D3d8333b7AD6a14d00e1700C80AF5A37F751 labelled as Cobo custody

Audit program: SlowMist Phase 1 and Phase 2; Code4rena + Blocksec + TenArmor Phase 3; Quantstamp + Zellic Phase 4 announced. Audit files stored as gitbook blobs (not directly fetchable URLs).
Protocol overview: SSI Protocol uses on-chain smart contracts to repackage multi-chain, multi-asset portfolios into Wrapped Tokens (SSI); canonical website https://ssi.sosovalue.com confirmed

protocol_metadata.about: SoSoValue Indexes (SSI) Protocol is an on-chain spot index product that repackages multi-chain, multi-asset portfolios into Wrapped Tokens (SSI) deployable on Base Chain, enabling passive index investing across crypto-native assets and RWAs. The SoDEX Bridge (Mirror Protocol) is the cross-chain interoperability layer enabling users to deposit assets from external networks — USDC and index tokens via Base Chain, and non-EVM assets (BTC, SOL, XRP) via third-party custody partners — which are then mirrored on the SoDEX EVM chain using a mint-and-burn mechanism secured by MPC and TEE validators. SoDEX itself is a high-performance order-book DEX running on ValueChain, a proprietary Layer-1 blockchain incubated by SoSoValue, supporting spot, perpetuals, and RWA trading with on-chain order matching.
